notes: Flip attempts. Open a recruit committed to another program (weeks 5 to 14) and work on a flip for 6 hours. Your pull on him plus a push from your recruiter level and perks goes against the other school's hold; he decides at the end of the week. Land him and the fans notice, rivalry heat rises, and a five-star gets confetti. Miss and his coach flew in the night you called. One flip at a time, one try per recruit per season.
